Bhujaṅgī
------------------------------------------
This is another name for the Kuṇḍa-linī power described in works on योग.
See KUṆḌALINĪ for details.

Bhujaṅginī-mudrā
(‘posture resembling the snake’)
------------------------------------------
Mudrās are yogic exercises described in works on हठयोग, like the Gheraṇḍa Saṁhitā. They are said to help in controlling the involuntary muscular and nervous systems.
Bhujaṅginī-मुद्रा is the last of the 25 mudrās described in the Gheraṇḍa Saṁhitā. It consists in extending the neck a little forward and drinking the air through the mouth by opening and expanding it a little.
All the disorders of the stomach, especially indigestion, are expected to be cured by this मुद्रा.
See also MUDRĀS.
